title: Poolside Plunge
description: Two overweight people, a man and a woman, are captured mid-jump into a glowing swimming pool at night. The man wears blue swim trunks while the woman wears a dark purple one-piece swimsuit, both surrounded by ripples, steam, and colorful neon reflections on the water.
